findings.message: Evidence capture unpacks exactly six effect-key components, so the required /m<k> suffix raises an exception before a provider call. The same file selects the full route for every call and tracks only one active adapter, preventing the required member assignment and safe concurrent cancellation.
findings.paved_road: Add the provider layer to the scope fence and cover member selection, evidence capture, and concurrent cancellation.

findings.message: Rework parses the final component of every requisition-review effect key as an integer; a paneled /m<k> key makes a later rework invocation raise ValueError.
findings.paved_road: Add this file to the scope fence and update its requisition-review sequence parsing for member keys.

findings.message: The statistics projection accepts only six-component LLM keys, so paneled stages disappear from its existing timing and review measurements.
findings.paved_road: Add the statistics projection and its affected tests to the scope fence and define how panel calls contribute to stage measurements.

findings.message: Diagnosis stem discovery excludes seven-component member keys, so panel-only diagnosis evidence can be omitted from training export.
findings.paved_road: Add the training exporter and its affected tests to the scope fence and recognize panel member keys.

findings.message: The existing scorecard ignores seven-component review keys, so paneled reviews lose their existing review evaluation and catch attribution; the ticket explicitly excludes scorecard changes.
findings.paved_road: Include preservation of existing review scorecard accounting in scope, or make this ticket depend on a change that provides it.

findings.message: The majority tie contract covers retry versus escalate and author versus declined, but diagnosis also permits split, reject, and abandon-human, and triage permits tombstone. The existing combiner raises ValueError for a tie involving an unlisted verdict, and no complete tie order is specified.
findings.paved_road: Specify tie outcomes for every valid diagnosis and triage verdict, and include the combiner owner if its orders must change.
